ruling.interpretation: The earlier upstream-provenance audit answers the narrower question whether FFD can be identified as a Wind/iFind/RQData/DataCube/Tushare export; it cannot. The later binding audit answers the actual frozen gate: whether the direct carrier has a stable, immutable vendor identity. FFD itself is the bound vendor through its versioned public-stable history contract. No upstream-brand equivalence is required or claimed.
